objectivesText: Slay 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres, and 7 Firegut Ogre Brutes, and return to Oralius when you are finished.

objectivesText: Find Gor'tesh, somewhere to the west of Dreadmaul Rock. Kill Gor'tesh and then take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head back to Oralius in Burning Steppes.

objectivesText: Take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head and place it at the top of Dreadmaul Rock. Look for a soft dirt mound to plant the pike.

objectivesText: Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.

objectivesText: Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of.
Bring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.

quests.name: Guarding Secrets

quests.name: Guarding Secrets

quests.name: Cap of the Scarlet Savant
objectivesText: In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

quests.name: Leggings of Arcana
objectivesText: In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

quests.name: Breastplate of Bloodthirst
objectivesText: In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

quests.name: Winterfall Firewater

quests.name: The Final Piece

quests.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets
objectivesText: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

quests.name: The Demon Forge
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

quests.name: Words of the High Chief
objectivesText: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

quests.name: Are We There, Yeti?
objectivesText: Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:
Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring)
Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris)
Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater)
When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

quests.name: Winterfall Intrusion
objectivesText: Rivern Frostwind wants you to slay 5 Winterfall Shaman and 5 Winterfall Ursa.

quests.name: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
objectivesText: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.

quests.name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril

objectivesText: Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

quests.name: Sweet Serenity
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.

quests.name: Corruption
objectivesText: Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

quests.name: The Everlook Report
objectivesText: Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff
objectivesText: Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Emberstrife
objectivesText: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
objectivesText: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.
You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
objectivesText: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
objectivesText: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz
objectivesText: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

quests.name: Ascension...
objectivesText: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.

quests.name: Trouble in Winterspring!
objectivesText: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.

quests.name: Enraged Wildkin
objectivesText: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.

quests.name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
objectivesText: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
Misty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows.
A Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.
Feralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas.
Savage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!

quests.name: Triage
objectivesText: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

quests.name: Beads for Salfa
objectivesText: The Winterfall are known to carry spirit beads to ward against foul spirits. These beads have clearly failed in their purpose, as the Winterfall themselves are the agents of corruption. Bring to me these spirit beads from fallen Winterfall furbolgs; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

quests.name: Jarl Needs a Blade
objectivesText: Bring a Moonsteel Broadsword to Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.

quests.name: Delicate Instruments
objectivesText: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.

quests.name: Delicate Instruments
objectivesText: Kill 8 Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.

quests.name: Stolen Enchanting Supplies
objectivesText: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.

quests.name: Good Steel
objectivesText: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.

quests.name: Downstream
objectivesText: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.

objectivesText: This quest has no objective text of its own – it is accepted and handed in.

objectivesText: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.

quests.name: Rare Books
objectivesText: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.

quests.name: Crate Expectations

quests.name: Book Inventory

quests.name: Shroud of the Winter Wilds

objectivesText: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

quests.name: A Little Payback
objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay 15 Strashasz Soldiers, 8 Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sergeant Ulka.

quests.name: Blood Red Bandanas
objectivesText: Enter Alcaz Prison and collect 8 Blood Red Bandanas from the human guards there.

quests.name: A Bit of Wet Work
objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay 15 Strashasz Soldiers, 8 Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sully McCleary.

quests.name: Camping 101: Cooking

quests.name: Your First Horse

quests.name: Learning to Ride
objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Randal Hunter.

quests.name: Halt the Hail
objectivesText: Search the southern hills of Winterspring for the giant known as Hailspite and recover the frost moss that grows upon him.

quests.name: Camping 101: Alchemy
objectivesText: Speak with Alchemist Mallory in Elwynn Forest near Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
objectivesText: Speak with Smith Argus in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Enchanting
objectivesText: Speak with Betty Quin in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Engineering
objectivesText: Speak with Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

objectivesText: Slay 8 Searing Hatchlings and 8 Searing Whelps.

objectivesText: Bring 20 Shed Dark Dragonscales to Drazzit Dripvalve.

quests.name: Sword in the Slime

quests.name: Shroud of the Winter Wilds
objectivesText: Bring 5 Chillwind Chimaera Fur and 5 Winterspring Owl Feathers to Evie Whirlbrew.

quests.name: A Net Disaster
objectivesText: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.

quests.name: An Enticing Offer
objectivesText: Collect 6 Vials of Animal Blood and 18 Duskweed Petals for murloc bait, then return to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire.

quests.name: Baited for Success

quests.name: Bottles and Baubles
